question: An electric field line diagram shows 12 lines originating from a positive charge $q_1$ and 4 lines terminating on a negative charge $q_2$. Based on the convention that the number of field lines is proportional to the magnitude of the charge, what can you infer about the ratio $q_1/|q_2|$?
